notes.title: Botanicula Gets Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
Dear plant friends,

We're happy to announce that you can now collect [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] and craft badges for Botanicula!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3496875/8e0f5f1ebd8f3a65408fe82c59c7688e70d93407.jpg[/img]

[h1]What we're adding:[/h1]
[list]
[*]8 trading cards
[*]5 regular badges + 1 foil badge
[*]5 profile backgrounds
[*]5 emoticons
[/list]
Have fun harvesting!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3496875/689d19850cf243016b8eb4e7d92946788381bdf0.png[/img]
